title: City Places Into Operational Status Ten School Zone Speed Cameras
summary: The City of Syracuse is operationalizing 10 school zone speed cameras across key school locations, following the success of the SZTE program. A 30-day warning period begins November 1, 2026, with $50 fines thereafter. Data shows a 65% reduction in daily speeding violations and 70% reduction in dangerous speeding over the first year, supporting Vision Zero traffic safety objectives.

political_signal.description: Mayor's public endorsement of traffic safety enforcement with quantified success metrics (65% violation reduction) signals commitment to Vision Zero and child safety priorities. Administrative expansion of program demonstrates confidence in technology-based enforcement effectiveness.

processing_notes: 10 specific school locations and street addresses provided for GIS mapping opportunity
